mapper.sql: child.session_id AS child_session_id, child.run_id AS child_run_id, child.parent_run_id AS parent_run_id, parent.session_id AS product_session_id, parent.target_kind AS origin_target_kind, parent.target_id AS origin_target_id, child.actor_agent_id AS source_agent_id, child.end_user_id AS end_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings child JOIN public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.run_id = child.parent_run_id AND parent.role = 'PRIMARY' WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND child.role = 'DELEGATE' AND parent.session_id = #{productSession} AND child.end_user_id = parent.end_user_id ORDER BY child.created_at, child.run_id
